---
##Shiny App Challenge
---


```{r}
library(shiny)
library(mapview)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
```



```{r}
county_data <- st_read(here("data/county_data.gpkg"))
```



```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Languages Spoken by County"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        "var",
        "Choose a language",
        choices = unique(county_data$language)
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      leafletOutput("map", height = "700px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    filtered_data <- county_data[county_data$language == input$var, ]
    
    mapview(
      filtered_data,
      zcol = "percent_speakers",
      layer.name = "Percent Speakers"
    )@map
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
